# Black Forest Labs FLUX Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.

A Muse agent skill that generates images with the FLUX.2 family via Black Forest Labs' official API: `flux-2-pro` for general text-to-image and native image editing, `flux-2-flex` for typography and text-heavy images. Every generation spends prepaid credit (from ~$0.014/image) — confirm before each generation. Result URLs expire in 10 minutes: download the sample immediately. Regional hosts exist for GDPR (`api.eu.bfl.ai`) and US (`api.us.bfl.ai`). Uses a BFL API key (dashboard.bfl.ai), kept in Muse's secure vault. Draft: written from BFL's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
